description: The connection L1 joins one PWR pin and one RTN pin of PCDU1 to two pins each of OBC1 (two junctions), so its harness W001 gets the splices W001-X1 and W001-X2; the pin currents say 4 A on the trunk and 2 A on each branch. The manual pages Connect two connectors and Splices explain it.
name: Splice from a connection (EXAMPLE)
